verdict.rationale: The only Linux-specific evidence is a secondhand HN account of Phoronix running 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL/Vulkan benchmarks on Linux, where the 5090 delivered 1.42x the RTX 4090's performance. That confirms the card works and was independently tested on Linux. Nothing in the first-party material documents Linux driver releases or Linux support; the product page instead pitches the card for 'your Windows PC'. Missing for 10: documented Linux driver releases or release notes for this GPU, first-party statement of Linux support, direct (not secondhand) independent Linux test reports, detail on driver openness or kernel-module status.
